test_title: SSC Selection Post HSC Level Official Paper (Held On: 30 June, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Ravi _______ to my house yesterday.
solution:
The correct answer is '**Came**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the given sentence, ***'Ravi _________ to my house yesterday.'***
 
• The given sentence is in **simple past tense** hence the correct option will also be in simple past tense.
 
• **option 1** is '**left' **but it is not used with '**to**' hence the only correct option is **option 2.**
 
• **option 3** and **option 4** are not in simple past tense.
 
• also contextually the word that is suitable from the given options is 'came'.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2** which is **'came'**.
